For [formats](/docs/shell/commands/categories/formats/).

<div class='command-title'>Decode a hex-encoded value.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> decode hex {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input  | output |
| ------ | ------ |
| string | binary |
## Examples

Decode arbitrary binary data
```nu
> "09FD" | decode hex
Length: 2 (0x2) bytes | null_char printable whitespace ascii_other non_ascii
00000000:   09 fd                                                _×

```

Lowercase Hex is also accepted
```nu
> "09fd" | decode hex
Length: 2 (0x2) bytes | null_char printable whitespace ascii_other non_ascii
00000000:   09 fd                                                _×

```
